scope: LONGHORN-48 native/dynamic/static CSI snapshot full-copy qualification; official design evidence only, not project PASS
notes: Snapshot CR with createSnapshot=true binds native source volume; request reentry and immutable-parameter rejection remain product integration assertions.
CSI snapshot type snap returns snap://volume/snapshot handle. Dynamic CSI creation and static import both restore through PVC VolumeSnapshot dataSource; source and target sizes must match.

V2 snapshot restore supports full-copy or linked-clone; StorageClass explicitly emits full-copy for this gate. Manager CSI maps snapshot handle to native dataSource and consumes cloneMode. Full-copy target identities and writes must remain independent.
V2 deletes the live-head parent snapshot with immediate merge and CR removal; V1 removed-CR persistence is not required.
Scope excludes integrity scan, external full/incremental backup, recurring jobs, SystemRestore and DR; those remain separate integration boundaries.
